   "source": [
    "# ARIMA: 時系列予測\n",
    "\n",
    "[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/tatsuki-washimi/gwexpy/blob/main/docs/web/en/user_guide/tutorials/advanced_arima.ipynb)\n",
    "\n",
    "このノートブックでは、`gwexpy` の `TimeSeries` クラスに追加された ARIMA 関連の機能（AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA/SARIMAX）を使用して、時系列データのモデリングと未来予測を行う方法を解説します。\n",
    "\n",
    "- **関連 API**: [Time Series API](../../reference/api/timeseries.rst)\n",
    "- **関連理論**: [検証済みアルゴリズム](../validated_algorithms.md), [数値安定性](../numerical_stability.md)\n",
    "\n",
    "## 準備\n",
    "\n",
    "必要なライブラリをインポートします。"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "metadata": {

   "source": [
    "import warnings\n",
    "\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import sklearn.utils.validation\n",
    "\n",
    "# Monkeypatch for pmdarima compatibility with scikit-learn >= 1.6\n",
    "_orig_check_array = sklearn.utils.validation.check_array\n",
    "\n",
    "def _patched_check_array(*args, **kwargs):\n",
    "    kwargs.pop(\"force_all_finite\", None)\n",
    "    return _orig_check_array(*args, **kwargs)\n",
    "\n",
    "sklearn.utils.validation.check_array = _patched_check_array\n",
    "\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\n",
    "    \"ignore\", message=r\".*force_all_finite.*\", category=FutureWarning\n",
    ")\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", category=FutureWarning, module=r\"sklearn\\..*\")\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\", category=FutureWarning, module=r\"pmdarima\\..*\")\n",
    "\n",
    "from gwexpy.timeseries import TimeSeries"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "10e50317",
   "metadata": {

     "duration": 0.016953,

   "source": [
    "## サンプルデータの作成\n",
    "\n",
    "ARIMAモデルの効果を確認するために、トレンド、季節性（周期性）、ノイズを含んだ模擬データを作成します。"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "46ae7b5e",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-02T12:30:36.177411Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-02T12:30:36.176861Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-02T12:30:51.981792Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-02T12:30:51.980373Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 15.826912,
     "end_time": "2026-07-02T12:30:51.983506+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-02T12:30:36.156594+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Plot size 1200x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Trend + Seasonality + Noise\n",
    "t0 = 0\n",
    "dt = 0.1\n",
    "duration = 30\n",
    "t = np.arange(0, duration, dt)\n",
    "n_samples = len(t)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Linear Trend\n",
    "trend = 0.3 * t\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Periodic component (Sine)\n",
    "seasonality = 2.0 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.2 * t)\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Noise\n",
    "np.random.seed(42)\n",
    "noise = np.random.normal(0, 0.8, n_samples)\n",
    "\n",
    "data = trend + seasonality + noise\n",
    "\n",
    "# Create TimeSeries object\n",
    "ts = TimeSeries(data, t0=t0, dt=dt, unit=\"V\", name=\"Sample Data\")\n",
    "\n",
    "ts.plot()\n",
    "plt.title(\"Original Data (Trend + Seasonality + Noise)\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## 1. AR (AutoRegressive) モデル\n",
    "\n",
    "ARモデルは、現在の値が過去の値に依存すると仮定するモデルです。\n",
    "`ts.ar(p)` メソッドを使用します。`p` は次数です。"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "15dac55c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-02T12:30:52.035615Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-02T12:30:52.035339Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-02T12:30:53.038558Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-02T12:30:53.036814Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 1.015408,
     "end_time": "2026-07-02T12:30:53.039379+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-02T12:30:52.023971+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Fit with order p=3\n",
    "model_ar = ts.ar(p=3)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Display model summary\n",
    "# print(model_ar.summary())\n",
    "\n",
    "# Plot results\n",
    "# forecast_steps specifies how many steps to forecast into the future\n",
    "model_ar.plot(forecast_steps=50, alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.title(\"AR(3) Model Forecast\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },

    "## 2. MA (Moving Average) モデル\n",
    "\n",
    "MAモデルは、現在の値が過去の予測誤差（ホワイトノイズ）に依存すると仮定するモデルです。\n",
    "`ts.ma(q)` メソッドを使用します。"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "34efa63b",

    "model_ma = ts.ma(q=3)\n",

    "model_ma.plot(forecast_steps=50, alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.title(\"MA(3) Model Forecast\")\n",
    "plt.show()"

    "ARとMAを組み合わせたモデルです。\n",
    "`ts.arma(p, q)` メソッドを使用します。"
   ]

    "## 4. ARIMA / Auto-ARIMA\n",
    "\n",
    "ARIMAモデルは、差分を取ることで非定常性（トレンドなど）を除去し、ARMAモデルを適用します。\n",
    "\n",
    "`ts.arima()` メソッドを使用します。\n",
    "`auto=True` オプションを指定すると、`pmdarima` ライブラリを使用して最適なパラメータ (p, d, q) を自動的に探索します。これが最も推奨される方法です。"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "try:\n",
    "    print(\"Searching for optimal ARIMA parameters... (this may take a few seconds)\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Seasonality can also be considered\n",
    "    # m is the number of steps in a seasonal period\n",
    "    model_auto = ts.arima(auto=True, auto_kwargs={\"seasonal\": True, \"m\": 50})\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Show info of the optimal model found\n",
    "    print(model_auto.summary())\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Plot results (Forecasting for a longer period)\n",
    "    ax = model_auto.plot(forecast_steps=100, alpha=0.5)\n",
    "    plt.title(\"Auto-ARIMA Model Forecast (Seasonal)\")\n",
    "    plt.show()\n",
    "except ImportError as e:\n",
    "    print(f\"Auto-ARIMA skipping: {e}\")\n"
   ]
  },

     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "if \"model_auto\" not in dir():\n",
    "    print(\"Auto-ARIMA model not available (pmdarima may be missing); skipping forecast.\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    steps = 50\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Get forecast values and confidence intervals\n",
    "    forecast_ts, intervals = model_auto.forecast(\n",
    "        steps=steps, alpha=0.5\n",
    "    )  # 50% confidence interval\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"Forecast Data:\")\n",
    "    print(forecast_ts)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\nConfidence Interval (Upper):\")\n",
    "    print(intervals[\"upper\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Forecasting data can be saved or used for other analysis\n",
    "    # forecast_ts.write(\"forecast.h5\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "## 6. 重力波データ解析における応用: ARIMAによるノイズ除去 (Whitening)\n",
    "\n",
    "重力波データ解析では、定常的な「有色ノイズ」の中から突発的なバースト信号やリングダウン波形を抽出するために、**白色化 (Whitening)** という処理が行われます。\n",
    "ARIMAモデルを背景ノイズの予測モデルとして学習させ、実測値からその予測値を引く（残差をとる）ことで、ノイズを除去し信号を強調することが可能です。"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "25494eea",
   "metadata": {
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.007693,
     "end_time": "2026-07-02T12:48:05.972285+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-02T12:48:05.964592+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": [
     "lang-ja"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "### Step 1: 有色ノイズの生成と信号の注入\n",
    "まず、低周波成分が強い有色ノイズ（AR(1)プロセス）を作成し、そこにそのままでは判別しにくい微弱な信号（サインガウシアン）を埋め込みます。\n",
    "※単位には Astropy で認識可能な \"strain\" を使用します。"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "986739c6",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-02T12:48:05.989137Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-02T12:48:05.988896Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-02T12:48:06.135377Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-02T12:48:06.134657Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.156033,
     "end_time": "2026-07-02T12:48:06.136214+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-02T12:48:05.980181+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "from gwexpy.timeseries import TimeSeries\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def generate_mock_data(duration=10, fs=1024):\n",
    "    t = np.linspace(0, duration, int(duration * fs))\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 1. Background Noise (AR(1) process with strong autocorrelation)\n",
    "    np.random.seed(42)\n",
    "    white_noise = np.random.normal(0, 1, len(t))\n",
    "    colored_noise = np.zeros_like(white_noise)\n",
    "    for i in range(1, len(t)):\n",
    "        colored_noise[i] = 0.95 * colored_noise[i - 1] + white_noise[i]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # 2. Injected Signal (Sine-Gaussian)\n",
    "    center_time = 5.0\n",
    "    sig_freq = 50.0\n",
    "    width = 0.1\n",
    "    signal = (\n",
    "        2.0\n",
    "        * np.exp(-((t - center_time) ** 2) / (2 * width**2))\n",
    "        * np.sin(2 * np.pi * sig_freq * t)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    data = colored_noise + signal\n",
    "    # Use a standard unit string that astropy/gwpy can recognize\n",
    "    return TimeSeries(data, t0=0, dt=1 / fs, unit=\"strain\", name=\"MockData\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "ts = generate_mock_data()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "plt.plot(ts, color=\"gray\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Original Noisy Data (Signal is hidden here)\")\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Time [s]\")\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle=\":\")\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },

    "print(\"Searching for optimal noise model parameters...\")\n",
    "# We prioritize AR model for whitening, so we set max_p=5 and max_q=0.\n",
    "model = ts.arima(auto=True, max_p=5, max_q=0)\n",
    "print(f\"Best model order: {model.res.model.order}\")\n",
    "print(model.summary())"

    "### Step 3: 残差（Residuals）の抽出と可視化\n",
    "モデルが予測した「定常ノイズ」を引くことで、残差 $x_r = x - \\hat{x}$ を求めます。これが白色化されたデータとなります。"
   ]

    "ts_whitened = model.residuals()\n",
    "ts_whitened.name = \"Whitened Data\"\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 8), sharex=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[0].plot(ts, color=\"gray\", alpha=0.5, label=\"Original\")\n",
    "ax[0].set_title(\"Original Noisy Data\")\n",
    "ax[0].legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax[1].plot(ts_whitened, color=\"red\", label=\"Residuals (Whitened)\")\n",
    "ax[1].set_title(\"Whitened Data (Signal is now visible!)\")\n",
    "ax[1].axvspan(4.8, 5.2, color=\"orange\", alpha=0.3, label=\"Injected Signal Position\")\n",
    "ax[1].legend(loc=\"upper right\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

    "### まとめ\n",
    "- `model.residuals()` を用いることで、複雑な数式を書かずに簡単に白色化処理が実行できます。\n",
    "- この手法は、重力波解析におけるバースト信号の探索や、イベント直後のリングダウン波形（指数減衰する正弦波）の抽出に非常に強力です。\n",
    "\n",
    "- **関連 API**: [Time Series API](../../reference/api/timeseries.rst)\n",
    "- **関連理論**: [検証済みアルゴリズム](../validated_algorithms.md), [数値安定性](../numerical_stability.md)"
   ]
  }
